title: Mapping from a description: liquid n-hexane, three beads
prompt: I want a three-bead coarse-grained model of liquid n-hexane. Propose the mapping I can use with ascg. Only propose it; do not build or run anything.

checks.expr: r['ok'] and r['species'][0]['beads_per_molecule'] == 3 and sorted(len(b['heavy_atoms']) for b in r['species'][0]['beads']) == [2, 2, 2]
